steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Hmm, how should I go about this?
You're walking past the lounge area when you catch sight of Luvia, dressed in her new white coat, gesticulating in front of the TV.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: "Failure, how I like the word!"

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: "The story of humankind is one about failures, one failure after another."

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: "This keeps us trapped in the draft phase, our lives merely endless rehearsals for a show that will never be staged."
Luvia mimics the actor on the screen, reading out the actor's lines.
Then it hits you: Luvia is in show business. She might know something about Deren's movie.
From what Deren said during yesterday's interrogation, you've inferred that the movie is called The Invitation to Dance. It is banned, probably due to the DisCars incident.

Plus there's a lot of irrelevant information about the name on the internet, so it's extremely difficult for you to even come by some appropriate review. But Luvia might know a thing or two about this high-profile movie in her field.
You come up to Luvia.
Sorry to bother you, Luvia, but do you have a minute?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Oh! It's you, Chief.
Luvia is delighted to see you.
I have some questions about the film industry to ask you, if it's not too much trouble.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Em? No problem at all! You might not believe it, but these days I have no trouble landing movie roles.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Please go ahead... what do you want to ask me about, Chief?
At the mention of the name, Luvia's eyes brighten.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Of course I have! She's the master of absurdness, the youngest winner of the DisCar for Best Director.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Her movies have a mysterious, outlandish feel to them, but they can be romantic at the same time. They are thought-provoking and open to interpretation. My point is... she's an extraordinary director.
Luvia smiles at you sheepishly, fiddling with the hem of her clothes.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I... I'm a big fan of hers.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Truth be told, I knew she was coming to the MBCC, so after her interrogation that day, I tracked her down and asked for her autograph.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Ta-da!
Luvia whips out a notebook from her pocket and opens it to the back. On the page is written Deren's name in paint.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: One of my dreams is to play a role in one of Deren's movies, even if it's just a minor one.
So... you must know about the movie that won her the best director award?

Luvia turns around and starts rummaging in the drawers of the TV cabinet. After a while, she turns back to you, a thumb drive in her hand. As she hands it to you, she waggles her eyebrows, looking all mysterious.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I'm a fan. Of course I know about the movie. But this is only the theatrical version. Apparently there is a director's cut—that's what they say on the internet, but no one has ever seen it before.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Let's watch it together, huh? I'll explain those bits you don't understand.
You insert the thumb drive into a USB port; you select and play the movie.
You dim the lights and sink into a beanbag chair. On the screen, intricate dark-colored patterns fade in, slowly transporting you to another world.

It is a POV shot. You are seeing through an unseen character's eyes, as if you are the character. In front of you, a pale, delicate hand flips open a roster book, then runs a red fingernail down a list of run-of-the-mill names.
The fingernail stops at an illegible name, and the pale hand takes your invitation.
Some time later, the pale hands make a welcoming gesture and push open a door that gives out an eerie red light. You enter the ballroom.

The ballroom is dimly lit. Next to the dance floor is a row of long chairs, seemingly out of place with their surroundings. Feeling lost and having no one to talk to, you walk over to sit down on one of the chairs.
Music comes on, which sounds to your ears like an impatient, irritated voice rushing you. Then a girl in a white dress stumbles into the room.
The girl comes over and sits beside you. You notice the plainness of her dress, and when you look down, you also notice a few inconspicuous white patches on the hem.

steps.speaker: Girl in White
steps.content: Sorry, I'm still a bit nervous.
She leans sideways toward you and whispers.

steps.speaker: Girl in White
steps.content: "Dancing among the clouds, lapped by the waves, but they weave a web of thorns."

steps.speaker: Girl in White
steps.content: I don't know if this is working. But they've told me I'll be happy.
The camera moves upwards to show the girl's face, delicate and graced with a gentle smile. She is staring at the dance floor.

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: Please come to the center of the dance floor, this lady in a white dress.

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: Someone will come, to accept you, help you, protect you, and...

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: Love you.

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: Go dance with him!
The eerie door opens again, and in walks a man whose entire face is shadowed. He comes up to the girl and bows slightly before her.

The music has turned cheerful and joyous, but somehow it sounds like an old train running on rusty rails, or notes played by filthy hands on a broken-down piano to your ears. In the dance floor, the two figures—one in white, the other in black, start twirling.
Slowly, the girl's long hair becomes up-do, while her white dress turns yellowish-gray. You hear the sound of cups and dishes breaking, followed by the shrill cry of a baby.
The smile on the girl's face is gone. Her face is now tear-stained and devoid of feeling.
The girl looks beyond her partner to where you are seated. She opens her mouth to say something, but nothing comes out.

The camera cuts to the dancers. The man places a wilted rose in the girl's pocket and takes her hand. They bow to the audience. Then comes another close-up of the girl's face. Her hair has come down, and she is wearing a sweet smile.

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: Everyone can find happiness! Every dream can come true!

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: How wonderful!
Murmurs of approval go around the circle, loud enough to drown out the whimpering sound.
No one knows where the sound is coming from, or where it might end up.
The camera pans over the crowd. Their faces are blurry, but each seems to carry a ghost of a smile.
You raise your hand. It seems that you have something to say, but before you can say anything, the eerie door opens once again.

steps.speaker: Pale-faced Boy
steps.content: Cough cough... Excuse me, is this seat taken?
The camera pans back to the seat that the girl occupied not long ago, and you see a pale-faced boy.
His neck, wrists, waist, and ankles are entangled in strange-looking vines. The vines look alive. A closer look shows that they're squirming, slowly making their way into his body.

steps.speaker: Pale-faced Boy
steps.content: I heard them talking outside.

steps.speaker: Pale-faced Boy
steps.content: Is it true that everyone can find happiness, and every dream can come true?
You don't know the answer, so you neither shake nor nod your head.

steps.speaker: Pale-faced Boy
steps.content: I hope that the people I love can live on... even...

steps.speaker: Pale-faced Boy
steps.content: Skin, organs, bones... they've come together to create me, and they'll come together to create them...

steps.speaker: Pale-faced Boy
steps.content: It's just that I don't know if I can last until... the dance is over.

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: Come on, kid, come and stand in the center.

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: They'll come, to help you, to protect you, to take care of you...

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: And the ones you care...

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: Your dream will come true.
The pale-faced boy stands up, nods at you, and walks into the dance floor.
He is flanked by two white-robed people in the dance floor, each wearing a face mask. You can't see their faces clearly, with the face masks and the red shadow covering their upper faces.
They take the boy's hands, lift him up, and lay him flat in mid-air, before putting him back down. A bizarre dance is afoot in the dance floor.

steps.speaker: Pale-faced Boy
steps.content: ...I'm so hungry. Are you hungry too?
From God knows where a black mass appears on the boy's top and starts expanding. It's located above his abdomen; slowly, it takes on a blood-curdling shape.
Then another black mass appears, then another... After a while, the masses become transparent and disappear entirely, like a magic trick.
The vines binding the boy are growing thicker and wilder. They're on the verge of tearing his tiny body apart.
But the boy is oblivious to all this. Standing on his feet again, he bows to the audience, as the music comes to an end.
He's still alive. He'll survive...

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: What a tough kid! How persistent!

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: You'll find happiness! All of you!
The guests murmur in appreciation and take off their hats as a gesture of respect.
A smile spreads across the boy's gaunt, pale face. He is clutching two dying roses in his hand.
The flowers are wilted, but their thorns are still sharp and tough. They've punctured his palm, but no liquid flows out.

Just like what happened with the girl, a close-up of the boy's face takes up the entire screen. He's smiling, seemingly content. Then the crowd breaks into rapturous applause, beating out a rhythm with their palms.
You are applauding too, you realize.

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: Are you truly wishing him well?
...Are you really?
Your hands are trembling. You are antsy; that much is clear.
You are seized by an overwhelming desire to leave the room, but you don't know how.
Amid the rhythmic applauding, a work song starts playing. But it's not a typical work song; it's rhythmic but lifeless.

steps.speaker: Young Woman in a Suit
steps.content: Are you okay?

steps.speaker: Young Woman in a Suit
steps.content: If you need help, just let me know.
The voice belongs to a young woman. She's wearing a suit, and is now sitting beside you.
She lays her hand gently on your wrist, and she sounds concerned.

steps.speaker: Young Woman in a Suit
steps.content: This isn't my first time here. If you're not feeling well, I could take you outside for a walk.
The young woman pulls you to your feet, eliciting a collective gasp of surprise from the guests. They start whispering, and some even retreat to the far side of the room out of fear.
You and the young woman head for the gate, cutting through the dense crowd and the harsh and dizzying light.
Light and shadow weave an intricate pattern on her. It looks like a suit of armor worn over her business suit.
...Or a tangle of ropes that bind her.

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: The ball has not ended yet. Please don't leave!

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: You can't leave!

steps.speaker: Spooky Female Voice
steps.content: Our expectations, our expectations of you... You must meet them this time!
The spooky voice rings out in the ballroom. As if encouraged, galvanized even, by the voice, the guests, who have been giving the two of you a wide berth, start closing in.
They start murmuring, but whether they're murmuring among themselves or to the two of you, you are not sure.

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: You can't leave! You're not allowed to leave!

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: The ball has not ended yet. You can't leave!

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: You're the star.

steps.speaker: Guest
steps.content: You're our hope.

steps.speaker: All the Guests
steps.content: You're a good kid.
The guests come at you and tear you away from the young woman.
Then they carry her into the dance floor, and put her in the center.
They take away the notebook in the young woman's pocket, remove the watch from her wrist, and change her flats for a pair of high heels.
The young woman's anxious eyes search the crowd, and they spot you.

steps.speaker: Young Woman in a Suit
steps.content: Leave! Get out of this place!
These are her last words to you.
She starts dancing in the crowd. Her black suit comes apart and becomes dark-brown overalls, and the overalls come apart and become a white gown.
Her clothes stop changing. Her eyes are no longer following you; she's looking at her partner, who is leading her step by step to the gate she has longed for.
With every step she takes, a rose petal falls. The petals come from the three roses pinned to her clothing over her chest.
The camera follows the young woman's footsteps out of the gate. The gate closes, and the screen goes black.
Is it over?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Of course not! Just hold on, wait for it.
Ten seconds later—or maybe a longer period, red light bursts through the screen.
Sprawling rose bushes and rose petals fill the entire screen.

Lying on the blanket of rose petals are the girl in white and her dance partner, with two cute babies between them; the pale-faced boy surrounded by his six siblings; and the young woman, who has changed out of her business suit and into a long soft-looking garment, lying against her dance partner's chest, holding his hand.

It's a romantic scene accompanied by romantic music. A breeze is ruffling their hair and clothes. From a distance, they all look happy. Then the camera pans closer; they open their eyes to look at the POV character, or you the viewer.
The next second, with the breeze still blowing, they close their eyes, as well as the window into their minds.
The end.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: What do you think? What do you think? It's very thought-provoking, right?
Luvia can't wait to know your opinion on the movie.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: It is really romantic and extremely bizarre. The mysterious door, the unconventional camerawork and dialogue, the romantic dances, and the sadly beautiful final scene.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: There are some places I can't quite wrap my head around, but that's probably because I'm not quite there yet, not savvy enough, not perceptive enough.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: After all, this is the movie that won so, so many DisCars. Deren knows how to capture romance on the screen; that's the consensus. And I'm sure of it.
Luvia stares at the rolling credits, her fists clenched.
Every character in the movie seems happy at the end. But is that the message of the movie? Are they really happy? Have their dreams come true in the end?
You don't have definite answers to these questions. The movie feels jarring throughout. It feels as if someone's trying to force a set of ideas on you.
Haha... do you really think so?
A voice intrudes. You look toward the doorway. Deren is leaning against the doorpost, looking at you and Luvia.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: De... Director Deren!

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Is that movie really that good, that awesome in your eyes?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I do, I really do. What they say on the internet is right. You have great taste and extraordinary skills, but...

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Yes?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: But as for my personal opinion of Miss Deren... I'll wait until I've known you better—if I have the privilege of spending time with you, that is.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Haha... You're so adorable.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: Then, what about you, Chief? What do you think?
Deren turns her attention to you, looking you in the eye. You have no choice but to answer her question.
I'm not a professional. But speaking as a layperson, I think it's a great movie.
It deserves all the awards it won.
It's a great movie. No doubt about it. And it deserves all the awards it won.
And you... you're a great director. I've seen your genius at work.
Deren clears her throat, a smile playing about her lips.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: You're not just saying that, are you?
I mean it.
There is one thing, though... The characters in the movie seem to have something more to say when they come around.
Does that mean... there's going to be a sequel?
Your question wipes the smile off Deren's face. She pulls down the hat to shield her eyes, making herself unreadable again.
Luvia looks at you, then at Deren, concerned. You give her a gentle wave of your hand, a gesture that tells her everything is all right.

steps.speaker: Deren
steps.content: That's not gonna happen. I'm under detention, Chief. Where would I find the time and money to make a sequel? But I'm okay with it. My film-making days are behind me.
She chuckles, pats you on the shoulder, and with a wave of her hand, turns to leave, ignoring your calling after her as she walks away.
You rush out. Outside, you find a notebook on the ground. The movie's name, The Invitation to Dance, is written on the cover.
